fieldValues.title: A person working with AI in Agent memory
fieldValues.summary: Someone directing agents that forget between sessions: they must hand over the context that matters and trust that agents recall it with its source.
goals: State assumptions once and have every agent read them
See where an agent got what it claims
Keep decisions an agent cannot re-derive
jobs: Hand over the context that matters
Replace re-reading sources with a brief an agent can trust
Check an agent's recall against its provenance
Keep decisions an agent cannot re-derive
fieldValues.needs: A way to state assumptions once that every agent recalls with provenance, and briefs that stand in for the source.
